description: Find GB railway stations by name or code. Returns each station's three-letter CRS code (e.g. KGX), its TIPLOC and whether it has step-free access. Use this to turn a place name into the code the other tools take.

includeJunctions.description: Also return junctions, yards and other non-station timing points.

query.description: Station name or code, e.g. 'kings cross', 'Leeds', 'MAN'.

name: search_stations
title: Search stations
